verses.english: “Mendicants, sentient beings join together and converge because of an element:
those who kill living creatures with those who kill living creatures,
consume beer, wine, and liquor intoxicants …

verses.pali: Pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā pāṇātipātā paṭiviratehi saddhiṁ saṁsandanti samenti;
verses.english: Those who refrain from killing living creatures …

verses.pali: adinnādānā paṭiviratā adinnādānā paṭiviratehi saddhiṁ saṁsandanti samenti;
kāmesumicchācārā paṭiviratā kāmesumicchācārā paṭiviratehi saddhiṁ saṁsandanti samenti;
musāvādā paṭiviratā musāvādā paṭiviratehi saddhiṁ saṁsandanti samenti;
surāmerayamajjappamādaṭṭhānā paṭiviratā surāmerayamajjappamādaṭṭhānā paṭiviratehi saddhiṁ saṁsandanti samentī”ti.
verses.english: those who refrain from consuming beer, wine, and liquor intoxicants with those who refrain from consuming beer, wine, and liquor intoxicants.”
